# OLAPH

OLAPH is an industry-independent business operations platform under development.
This release is a public product preview and a browser-local demonstration, not a production business system.
Demo functions include materials, decimal-safe inventory movements, orders, partners, purchase requests, CSV import/export and activity history.
Available interface languages: Turkish, English, Arabic (RTL), Chinese and Russian.
Real company accounts, billing, AI, email, production stations and external integrations are not enabled.
